title: The type checker runs in strict mode
rationale: Typed Python catches the errors a compiled language would.

title: Ruff is configured
rationale: One fast tool for lint and format removes style debates.

title: Warnings fail the tests
rationale: filterwarnings = error surfaces deprecations before they break.

title: The Python version is declared
rationale: requires-python makes the supported interpreter explicit.

title: The standard library is preferred over third-party packages
rationale: pathlib, dataclasses, tomllib, argparse and asyncio cover a lot without new supply chain.

title: Ruff enables every rule
rationale: With select ALL every exception is a written, reasoned ignore entry, and new rules arrive with the next Ruff update instead of never.
hint: Set select = ["ALL"] in [tool.ruff.lint] and give every ignore entry a comment (templates/python/pyproject.toml).

title: Formatting is checked in the gate
rationale: A formatter that only runs on request drifts; ruff format --check makes unformatted code fail like a failing test.
hint: Run ruff format --check in the gate and name it in CLAUDE.md, the verify script or the pipeline.

title: The interpreter version is pinned for the tools
rationale: .python-version makes uv, pyenv and CI use the interpreter the project is tested with, instead of whatever the machine has.

title: Type-ignore comments name their error code
rationale: A bare type: ignore silences every future error on the line; with ignore-without-code mypy accepts only the one that was meant.

title: Mistyped test markers and passing xfails fail
rationale: A misspelt marker silently skips nothing and selects nothing; an xfail that starts passing hides a fixed bug or a broken test.

title: Locked runtime dependencies are audited in the gate
rationale: pip-audit over the exported lock file checks exactly what production installs, wherever the pipeline runs.
hint: uv export --no-dev --no-emit-project --format requirements-txt into a file, then pip-audit --strict --requirement on it.
